overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic and professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, reaching a combined audience of 3,580 followers. His content is highly specialized, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated behavior. He achieves strong engagement, particularly when announcing major publications, funding grants, or academic hiring opportunities, demonstrating an active and invested professional community across all three networks.

contentThemes.description: Research findings, paper publications, and presentations focused on detecting coordinated link sharing and information operations.
Announcements regarding software updates (e.g., CooRnet) and methodological approaches to studying multi-platform social media data.
Job openings, postdoctoral hiring, and PhD student recruitment within computational social science.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's high engagement rate by utilizing it for real-time discussion, QA sessions on newly published papers, and early research previews.
Leverage LinkedIn's large follower base (over 50% of total audience) to post regular updates about project progress, which can funnel traffic to technical tool releases on Mastodon.
Incorporate visual media, such as data visualizations or paper abstract graphics, to boost organic reach and shareability across all platforms.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky yields the highest relative engagement rates (average of 6.14%), acting as a highly responsive environment for immediate peer feedback, paper launches, and research recruitment.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon serves as a dedicated channel for technical and developer-focused tool updates (e.g., CooRnet v2.0), showing moderate engagement from a highly specialized, academic audience.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn represents the largest audience hub, driving the highest absolute volume of engagements. It is exceptionally effective for professional milestones like research grants and hiring announcements.
